blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Another way of scrutinizing the tax documents of Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, Manases Carpio, is asking why the couple’s declared net worth is higher than the income they were taxed for from 2007 to 2025, the prosecution said on Thursday. In a press briefing after the impeachment trial, prosecution spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers was asked to clarify what the issue is if Duterte’s income after taxes from 2007 to 2025 was at P85.34 million, and if her 2025 Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN) valuation was at P98.65 million.
